content: I often have many files open in VSCode at the same time. When I click on the "Restart Server" button from the forall symbol dropdown menu, it starts Lean for all the Lean files I have open all at once, which takes a while. Is there a way to only run Lean on the one file I'm looking at right now, instead of for every single tab I have open?

Why do you have to restart the server? Will "restart file" do? I only click "restart server" when there is some problem with the server (e.g. if I've just changed to a different branch with a different version of Lean) and then I probably want to restart the server on all the files anyway.

I always run "Lean 4: Server: Stop Server" before getting the cache because there have been many times in the past I get cache without stopping the server and it fails to get cache properly because one of the olean files is being used by the server so lake exe cache get fails with "can't write to an open file" error. If I click "restart file" after stopping the server I get "No active client for 'KrullTopology.lean'."
Do you know about the commands "fetch mathlib build cache for ..."?
yes, I never use it because it's more clicks/more typing
